candidate: per-class temperature and bias plus learned reliability-conditioned background

diagnosis.source_class_coverage: Only 10 of the 19 evaluation classes have nonzero labeled mass anywhere in the three frozen fit scenes, and individual LOSO fit pairs cover fewer classes.
diagnosis.unseen_class_failure: Independent per-class parameters cannot be learned for classes absent from a fit pair and therefore do not define a transferable cross-scene calibration rule.
diagnosis.background_mismatch: Mass outside the 19 evaluation classes was trained as a predicted background class, although the frozen ScanNet OVS evaluation ignores non-evaluation ground-truth labels; this encourages excessive abstention.
diagnosis.reliability: The earlier paper-eight development pilot already showed zero discrete effect when reliability was ablated, so reliability-conditioned background complexity is not justified by current evidence.

decision.next_candidate: A low-dimensional target-blind marginal calibration shared across all classes, trained only on foreground-labeled source rows and able to act on classes unseen in a source fit fold.
